If the team does not compete or does not win for any reason, the market will settle to No. If the tournament is delayed, postponed, or suspended and not rescheduled to a date within two weeks of the originally scheduled date, the market will settle to the last fair market price. Outcome sourced from NCAA.
markets.title: Xavier
